title: Area-code shard C pass 35 — 872 / 878 / 908

data.research_question: Which current or historically relevant public organizations, public organizational actors, and communication surfaces can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 872, 878, and 908?
data.method: Bounded deterministic shard-C area-code enumeration using current NANPA geographic membership, literal and locality-derived searches, first-party/current-status verification, repository dedupe, public organizational-role enumeration, seed-family expansion, and explicit uncertainty handling. X and Reddit discovery did not depend on official APIs.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from organizational proximity, volunteering, attendance, membership, public role, or event participation.
Do not merge organizations or people from name or handle similarity alone.
Public person-org relations are directly stated unless qualifiers explicitly mark an inference.
For overlay/locality-derived NPA hits, geographic association does not imply a published phone number unless directly evidenced.

findings.notes: Added Brave Space Alliance from direct 872 first-party contact and current mutual-aid programming, plus 19th District Mutual Aid from its current first-party Chicago operations. Nikki Patin is retained only as BSA's directly stated current CEO; no ideology inferred.

Reused canonical The Big Idea Bookstore & Café after current first-party re-verification of its explicit anarchist-collective self-description; added Pittsburgh Really Really Free Market as a current mutual-aid initiative. Old Pittsburgh Mutual Aid and Northeast Anarchist Network material remain discovery/history only.

Added Mutual NJ, whose current site includes a Union County surface, and Union County DSA, whose current 2026 public pages establish Elizabeth locality and mutual-aid programming. Union Food Not Bombs appeared in current secondary food-directory discovery but lacked sufficient first-party/current-status evidence for promotion in this bounded pass.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization and public-organizational-role enumeration pass

summary: Bounded shard-C organization and public organizational-role enumeration covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 872, 878, and 908.
